## About
Stinson Automotive is a local family owned repair shop in Northeast Minneapolis, owned and operated by David Hansen and his wife LeAnn. David grew up in the northeast area and has known many of his customers for years.
David is an active member of AASP-MN, the Alliance for Automotive Service Professionals. He believes a shop should be active in its community and supportive of the local schools and parks.
Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 137 Google reviews. When your car needs work, give us a call and we'll set up a time.

## Services
- Troubleshooting: Finding the actual cause of a problem instead of swapping parts.
- Suspension service: One customer had a full suspension service done and was offered a plan to break the work into safe stages.
- Turbo, battery and AC: A reviewer had a turbo replaced, the battery checked out and the AC fixed.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get my car in?
A: Give us a call to schedule an appointment.

Q: Who runs the shop?
A: Stinson Automotive is owned and operated by David Hansen and his wife LeAnn.
